name: reports_automata_compile_scan_and_4k_tail_latency

test_list.description: Measures compile time, meta-engine memory usage, scanner throughput at 10/100/1,000 patterns, 4 KiB any_match p99, and a 512 MiB scan.
Compares default and zero-full-DFA-budget scanner memory/build cost and verifies identical matches over no-match, single-match, and multi-match inputs; regex-automata may use its lazy fallback.

inputs.name: haystack
inputs.description: No-match 4 KiB sample and 1 MiB stream chunk.

output_description: Release-mode timings and engine memory usage are emitted as raw key/value lines under @prime/tmp/p2.
